data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nikolaos total 33, reducing to 6. Number 6 is associated with responsibility, care and harmony.

biblical_reference.note: Nikolaos was a member of the first seven deacons appointed by the apostles in Jerusalem. He was also the companion of Paul and Barnabas on their first missionary journey.
